blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alpha Insurance got its second straight win in less than 24 hours, sweeping the hapless Armed Forces of the Philippines, 25-19, 25-21, 25-15, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Thursday at Philsports Arena. Axel Van Book led the Protectors for the second consecutive game with 13 points and four digs, while Reymark Betco sparked the bench with 10 points. “From the moment the schedule was released, we already studied how we would structure our training.
